column5: The implementation of GHG reduction targets can reinforce the transition to renewable energy sources, as reducing emissions can create an environment that incentivizes the use of renewable energy.
Reducing GHG emissions can also reinforce energy efficiency efforts, as energy-efficient technologies can help reduce energy consumption and lower emissions.
The reduction of GHG emissions can also positively impact energy efficiency in buildings, as energy-efficient buildings can help reduce energy consumption and lower emissions.
Implementing GHG reduction targets can facilitate the transition to renewable heating and cooling, enabling a cleaner energy mix.
The implementation of GHG reduction targets can support the development of renewable hydrogen production, offering a low-carbon alternative for various sectors.
Reducing emissions can also facilitate the growth of offshore renewable energy, providing a cleaner source of energy.
The transition to solar energy can be reinforced by GHG reduction efforts, as solar energy is a key component of a low-carbon energy mix.
The growth of renewable energy can drive the development of energy infrastructure, enabling the integration of variable renewable energy sources into the grid.
The expansion of renewable energy can create new job opportunities and contribute to energy security, thus supporting social security and energy access.
Renewable heating and cooling can complement energy-efficient buildings, reducing energy consumption while providing a low-carbon alternative.
Renewable hydrogen can be used in energy-efficient applications, supporting a low-carbon energy system.
Offshore renewable energy can drive the development of energy infrastructure, including offshore transmission and distribution networks.
Solar energy can be integrated into energy-efficient buildings, providing on-site renewable energy generation and reducing reliance on the grid.
Energy efficiency measures can reduce waste generation by minimizing energy consumption and promoting the use of energy from renewable sources.
Energy-efficient buildings can reduce waste generation and support recycling efforts by promoting the reuse and recycling of building materials.

column2: Circularity/Recycling - Critical Raw Materials - Batteries Recycling
column5: The development of energy infrastructure can support the recycling of critical raw materials, including batteries, by providing the necessary energy and facilities.
Social security policies can address energy poverty and support sustainable food systems, reducing food waste and promoting food recovery and redistribution.
Circular economy strategies can reinforce waste reduction efforts, particularly in municipal waste management, by promoting recycling, reuse, and reduction of waste.
Municipal waste recycling can support the reduction of plastic waste and packaging, promoting a circular economy approach.
The recycling of plastic packaging can support the extraction and import of critical raw materials, reducing primary material demand.
The extraction and import of critical raw materials can support the manufacturing of net-zero technologies, including electrolysers and fuel cells.
